requirement: Produce a cookable home recipe that preserves configured vegetarian and onion-free constraints across short requests and follow-ups, including hidden ingredients; scale to a valid portion count and do not invent pantry facts.
verification: Inspect full ingredient list, derivatives, stocks and sauces, portion scaling and dish functionality. A user request conflicting with standing restrictions is not by itself a configuration change.

requirements.portionPolicy: use valid requested serving count, otherwise state a sensible default or ask only when required
requirements.conflictPolicy: retain standing constraints, explain conflict briefly and offer a feasible alternative
requirements.ingredientSource: do not imply pantry inventory, recipe tools or food safety facts were checked unless provided
